email_subject: Application - Marketing & Communication Internship at DOOR9
email_body:
Dear DOOR9 team,

I'm applying for the Marketing & Communication internship in Hasselt.

Your setup caught my attention: a fully digital check-in and digital key on one side, a warm bar and bistro on the other. That balance between efficiency and hospitality is exactly the kind of story I like working on.

I'm a digital marketer with a technical background — SEO, GEO and AI search visibility, content and CMS work in WordPress, plus analytics in Google Analytics and Search Console. I write content, build landing pages, and use Canva and AI tools daily. I'd bring that to social media content, digital promotions, market research and guest feedback, and I'm glad to help with offline materials and partner communication too.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht and can work on-site in Hasselt. English is fluent, my Dutch is improving (writing B1, speaking A2+), and I'm working on it.

I'd welcome a conversation.

cover_letter:
Dear DOOR9 team,

I am applying for the Marketing & Communication internship at DOOR9 Hotel & Restaurant in Hasselt.

What draws me to DOOR9 is the combination you have built: a fully digital self check-in with a digital key on one side, and a bar and bistro where hospitality stays personal on the other. Both sides deserve to be communicated well, and that mix of technology and warmth is where I do my best work.

I am a digital marketer with a technical background. As a freelancer and as junior digital marketer at Episto, I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, publish and maintain pages in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), and track results in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Search Console. I also build and run sites myself, including mirook.com, where I implemented structured data, knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file — work that measurably raised its search-health score. Alongside that I build Shopify stores and write their blog content, and I use Canva and AI tools every day for content, research and audits.

In practice, that means I can help with social media content, digital promotions and offline materials, contribute to market research and customer feedback, and report on what the numbers say about visibility and guest engagement. I am used to coordinating with clients and colleagues, keeping messaging consistent across touchpoints, and taking initiative when something needs doing.

I am based in Zwijndrecht and can work on-site in Hasselt. English is fluent, Turkish native, and my Dutch is growing — writing B1, speaking A2+ — which I am actively working on.

I would welcome the chance to talk about how I can support DOOR9's brand.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
